app.name: prism-holon
app.title: Prism Holon
app.purpose: Decides what the Prism's observer does next for one of its facets, the Prism itself and the owner among them: hold the facet as it is, reconcile it toward the owner, curate it (try a Rule-30 hypothesis), restore its floor, or refuse. The observer turns its attention to the Prism including the owner: it changes a facet only on the owner's own gestures, never on its own measures alone, never while halted, never below the floor, and never for the sake of change when the owner and the Prism agree.

fields.name: halted
fields.means: whether the owner pressed the kill switch

fields.name: floor
fields.means: whether the facet's floor (its parameters as first modeled) Pareto-dominates what the facet runs now (regressed) or not (held)

fields.name: signal
fields.means: whether the window holds at least the minimum of the owner's own gestures on this facet (owner) or only the Prism's own measures (self)

fields.name: tunable
fields.means: whether the facet's spec marks any parameter tunable

fields.name: dissonance
fields.means: the share of what the facet brought forward that the owner undid or dismissed: none, below the high band, or at or above it

fields.name: kpi
fields.means: whether the facet's measured KPI (the share of what it brought forward that the owner kept) is at or above the facet's floor

meanings.hold: the facet stays as it is
meanings.reconcile: the facet moves toward the owner
meanings.curate: the facet tries one Rule-30 hypothesis
meanings.restore: the facet returns to its floor

rules.says: when halted is yes then refuse
rules.why: Prism Holon: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when floor is regressed then restore
rules.why: Prism Holon: the decision tree's path to restore

rules.says: when signal is self then hold
rules.why: Prism Holon: the decision tree's path to hold

rules.says: when tunable is no then hold
rules.why: Prism Holon: the decision tree's path to hold

rules.says: when dissonance is high then reconcile
rules.why: Prism Holon: the decision tree's path to reconcile

rules.says: when kpi is missed then curate
rules.why: Prism Holon: the decision tree's path to curate

rules.says: when dissonance is some then curate
rules.why: Prism Holon: the decision tree's path to curate

app.otherwiseWhy: Prism Holon: the decision tree's path that meets no test

properties.says: always when halted is yes then refuse
properties.why: the kill switch stops the observer too: nothing changes while halted

properties.says: never when halted is no then refuse
properties.why: the observer refuses only while halted; otherwise it always answers for the facet

properties.says: always when halted is no and floor is regressed then restore
properties.why: the floor never regresses: when the first-modeled parameters dominate what runs, they come back

properties.says: never when signal is self then reconcile
properties.why: self-reference alone is bounded: the Prism never changes itself on its own measures without the owner's gestures

properties.says: never when signal is self then curate
properties.why: self-reference alone is bounded: the Prism never changes itself on its own measures without the owner's gestures

properties.says: never when tunable is no then reconcile
properties.why: only parameters a facet's spec marks tunable are ever changed

properties.says: never when tunable is no then curate
properties.why: only parameters a facet's spec marks tunable are ever changed

properties.says: always when halted is no and floor is held and signal is owner and tunable is yes and dissonance is high then reconcile
properties.why: high dissonance between the owner and the Prism is reconciled toward the owner before anything is explored

properties.says: never when dissonance is high then curate
properties.why: the Prism never experiments on an owner it is already at odds with

properties.says: never when dissonance is none and kpi is met then reconcile
properties.why: nothing changes for the sake of change when the owner and the Prism agree

properties.says: never when dissonance is none and kpi is met then curate
properties.why: nothing changes for the sake of change when the owner and the Prism agree

properties.says: never when floor is held then restore
properties.why: a floor that still holds is never restored over what the owner has shaped
